verdict.rationale: mParticle's own marketing describes an in-product agent that understands customer data and suggests audience logic, offers 'recommendations grounded in your data' with inspectable reasoning, and scores churn, conversion and value likelihood. That is direct AI-generated suggestions from the user's data, but the evidence is only homepage taglines, with no product docs explaining how insights are generated or surfaced. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the AI insight and recommendation feature, details on what insights beyond audience logic are produced, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use, and helps turn intent into revenue-driving activation.
Reasoning you can inspect and refine
Score likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value, then activate audiences before risk or opportunity passes.
